title: Unlocking Expertise: How Mastermind.com Aims to Revolutionize Knowledge Entrepreneurship
summary: Mastermind.com, a platform co-founded by Dean Graziosi and Tony Robbins, aims to empower coaches, consultants, and creators to transform their specialized knowledge into scalable businesses. It provides tools, strategies, and community support to help individuals monetize their expertise effectively in the burgeoning creator economy.
content:
In an increasingly digitized world where personal expertise is currency, Mastermind.com emerges as a potent force, designed to empower a new breed of entrepreneur. This education and business-building platform, a collaborative effort by renowned entrepreneur Dean Graziosi and motivational icon Tony Robbins, targets coaches, consultants, creators, and anyone aspiring to transform their specialized knowledge into a thriving enterprise.

The premise is elegantly simple yet profoundly impactful: take what you know best and build a scalable business around it. Mastermind.com offers a structured ecosystem to achieve just that. Far beyond mere informational courses, it provides a robust suite of tools, step-by-step methodologies, and community support crucial for navigating the often-complex journey from subject matter expert to successful business owner. Think guidance on crafting compelling offers, optimizing marketing strategies, and streamlining sales processes – all within a unified environment.

In an era saturated with digital content and fleeting online trends, the challenge for knowledge-based professionals isn't just creating value, but effectively monetizing and scaling it. Mastermind.com aims to demystify this path, leveraging Graziosi’s proven business frameworks and Robbins’ profound insights into human psychology and performance. The platform's goal is to equip individuals with the actionable strategies necessary to stand out, attract their ideal audience, and build sustainable revenue streams from their unique expertise.

This venture signifies a significant evolution in the creator economy, offering a powerful resource for those ready to embrace entrepreneurship rooted in their personal brand and intellectual capital. Mastermind.com positions itself not merely as a learning portal, but as a launchpad for the next wave of impactful knowledge entrepreneurs, striving to turn passion and proficiency into lasting prosperity.
keyTakeaways: Mastermind.com is an education and business-building platform founded by Dean Graziosi and Tony Robbins.
It targets coaches, consultants, and creators, providing tools and strategies to monetize their specialized knowledge.
The platform aims to simplify the process of building scalable businesses in the evolving creator and knowledge economy.
author: Matt Walsh

title: Wider Horizons: Samsung's Z Fold 9 Preps for a More Immersive Foldable Era
summary: Samsung is set to launch the Galaxy Z Fold 9 with a significantly broader display, aiming to deliver a more immersive and practical foldable experience. This wider design is part of a larger strategy by Samsung, which plans to introduce five distinct foldable models by 2027, solidifying its commitment to leading the future of mobile computing.
content:
Samsung, the undisputed titan of foldable tech, isn't slowing its relentless push to redefine the smartphone landscape. Hot on the heels of its latest offerings, whispers from the industry confirm that the upcoming Galaxy Z Fold 9 is poised to deliver a significantly broader and more immersive display experience, marking a crucial evolution in its signature foldable line. This isn't just about a bigger screen; it's about optimizing the aspect ratio, making the device feel even more like a pocketable tablet when unfolded, perfectly balancing portability with productivity.

Sources close to Samsung indicate that the Z Fold 9's expanded display aims to tackle some of the user experience challenges present in earlier models. Imagine spreadsheets with more visible columns, videos filling a wider canvas without awkward black bars, or seamless split-screen multitasking where each app gets ample room to breathe. This strategic pivot towards an "extra wide" format suggests Samsung is listening to user feedback, striving to make the foldable form factor not just innovative, but genuinely more practical for everyday power users.

But the Z Fold 9 is merely one piece of a much larger, ambitious puzzle. Samsung is reportedly planning to introduce a staggering five distinct foldable models by 2027. This aggressive roadmap signals a profound commitment to the foldable future, moving beyond premium niche devices to potentially offer a range of price points and form factors. From flip-style devices to even more radical designs, this diversification could be the catalyst for mainstream adoption, challenging traditional slab phones across every segment.

This isn't just a product launch; it’s a strategic declaration. Samsung is doubling down on foldables as the next major frontier in mobile computing. With each iteration, and particularly with the Z Fold 9's wider vision, they're not just selling a phone; they’re selling a glimpse into a future where your device adapts to you, seamlessly shifting between compact and expansive, entertainment and productivity. The era of the truly adaptable smartphone is not just coming; Samsung is actively building it, one wider fold at a time.
keyTakeaways: The Galaxy Z Fold 9 will feature an "extra wide" display, enhancing immersion and practicality for users.
This design change aims to optimize the aspect ratio for better multitasking and media consumption.
Samsung plans an aggressive expansion into the foldable market, targeting five distinct models by 2027.
author: Roland Hutchinson
